maria_cs: heads-up from onboarding calls today 1w 1  three customers called out same two issues: unexplained per-route cost spikes and chat latency when batching short messages.

maria_cs: quick summary: 1) per-route cost breakdown/export 2) per-route opt-out for continuous batching 3) ability to pin embedding model per integration (lower priority).

zoe_csm: Acme flagged cost mapping as a renewal blocker (renewal ~5w). they asked for a CSV that maps requests -> bill lines.

sam_pm: agree we should triage. batching opt-out seems fast; billing export is medium. who can spike opt-out?

anya_eng: I can do a small runtime change to skip batching for routes that opt-out. estimate: 1 sprint + telemetry. default stays batching on.

maria_cs: can someone export 14d traces for acme including tokens, batching flag, latency_ms, and route? i'll pull 200 short prompts for quality checks.

triage-bot: @maria_cs created ticket CS-1722: "Per-route cost visibility + batching opt-out" and added label renewal-risk.

zoe_csm: customer quote to keep: "We see random invoice spikes and can't map them to behavior." and "Batching kills latency on short chats."

sam_pm: next steps: anya spike opt-out, infra trace export, cs prompt sample + eval, product note for prioritization. i'll draft impact note and attach to CS-1722.

maria_cs: thanks all  i'll post the sync notes after the GTM meeting. :rocket:
